lcc_original: 永恆主上帝吩咐那人說：『園中各樣樹的果子、你都可以喫：
notes: LCC renders יְהוָה as 永恆主 (Eternal Lord) rather than UNV's phonetic 耶和華; SN H03068 attached to 永恆主
LCC renders אָדָם as 那人 (that person) rather than UNV's pronoun 他; SN H0120 attached to 那人
{<WAH05921>} (implicit עַל) retained as braced implicit — LCC also has no explicit word for this preposition

Hebrew infinitive absolute אָכֹל (H0398/WTH8800) mapped to 都, which carries the emphatic/completive force in LCC's construction 都可以喫, paralleling UNV's 隨意吃; finite verb תֹּאכֵל (H0398/WTH8799) mapped to 喫
